messages.subject: Google Group pages spammed
parts:
Hi,

unfortunately some spam bot registered itself as a member and spammed
several of the group pages. As a first step I have removed edit
privileges to members (only moderators can edit pages now). I'm
starting to revert the pages back to previous versions, but that will
take some time.

Sorry about this

Henrik

messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Re: Google Group pages spammed
parts:
Hi again,

a follow up on all the spam added March 9. I have not gone through
all pages manually and reverted them to version before the spam bot
was running. If I you find a page with spam that I have missed,
please let me know.

Also, if you notice similar hijacks in the future, please post a
message ASAP to the list so I can prevent it as early as possible.
For now, I will keep the rule that only moderators can edit pages,
meaning members can no longer edit pages. If you want to edit/create
your own pages, please let me know and I upgrade you to a moderator.

Details: It was a quite sophisticated spam bot, because it managed to
pesticide all but 10-15 pages before the Google Spambot detector
stopped it. As a comparison, when I started to revert the pages back,
my repetitive behavior caused to Google (multiple times) to think I
was a spammer: "We're sorry... ... but your query looks similar to
automated requests from a computer virus or spyware application. To
protect our users, we can't process your request right now.". The
spam bot used nickname '621557649670' under email address
'doremi...@gmail.com'.


Cheers

Henrik
